full_prompt_en: A luminous Impressionist oil painting views a woman from behind as she stands at a narrow iron balcony overlooking a garden pond. She wears a light ivory blouse with soft gathered sleeves and a long dark skirt, her brown hair swept into a loose bun. One hand rests lightly on the railing while her head turns toward a bright opening through the foliage. The slender metal rail runs horizontally across the lower middle, with simple vertical bars that separate the near terrace from the water below. Dense trees and shrubs frame both sides of the composition, their leaves rendered as thousands of broken green, blue-gray, and gold marks. Beyond the woman, a pool or stream catches pale sunlight in irregular silver patches. The brightest light pours from the upper center and filters through misty leaves, making the distant garden appear hazy and almost weightless. The figure's back is partly silhouetted against this glow; warm highlights edge her shoulders, hair, and sleeve, while the skirt remains a deep olive-charcoal mass. At the lower corners, small red and yellow flowers punctuate the shadowed foliage. Paint is applied in layered short strokes and soft dabs rather than hard outlines. Near rail lines remain relatively crisp, but leaves and far water merge into shimmering texture. The palette is restrained yet rich in variation: moss, olive, gray-green, pale gold, ivory, and cool blue, with only a few warm floral sparks. The composition feels secluded and contemplative, balancing a still upright figure with the restless flicker of light across plants and water.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅发光的印象派油画从背后看一名女子站在狭窄铁栏阳台上，俯望花园池水。她穿浅象牙上衣，袖子柔和收褶，配长深裙，褐发松松挽髻。一只手轻搭栏杆，头转向叶间明亮开口。细金属栏杆横过下方中部，简单竖条把近处露台与下方水分开。密树与灌丛框住构图两边，叶子被画成数千个断绿、蓝灰和金色笔点。女子身后，一池水或溪流以不规则银色片块接住浅日光。最亮光从上方中央倾下，透过薄雾叶子，使远方花园朦胧近乎失重。人物背部在这辉光前部分成影；暖亮线勾住肩、发和袖，裙子则保持深橄榄炭色大块。下方两角，小红黄花点亮阴影叶丛。颜料以层叠短笔与柔点涂布，而非硬轮廓。近栏杆线相对清楚，叶子与远水却融入闪烁纹理。调色克制却变化丰富：苔、橄榄、灰绿、浅金、象牙与冷蓝，仅有少量暖花火星。构图隐秘而沉思，以静止竖向人物平衡光在植物与水上的不安闪烁。
style_prompt_en: Luminous Impressionist oil painting gathers broken short strokes and soft dabs into a dense, shimmering field. Moss, olive, gray-green, cool blue, pale gold, and ivory intermix in small marks; a few red and yellow points punctuate the lower shadow. A dark upright mass sits before a bright central opening, with thin horizontal and vertical lines giving the loose environment a simple structural frame. Light filters from high behind, grazing selected edges and scattering into irregular silver patches on a lower reflective plane. Near linear details stay relatively crisp, while surrounding foliage and distant forms dissolve into layered texture and haze. Shadows retain colored green-brown depth rather than flat black. The composition is intimate and secluded, holding one still shape amid restless optical flicker. Its rhythm comes from the contrast between quiet broad masses, delicate rails, and myriad small light-bearing brush marks.
style_prompt_zh: 发光印象派油画把破碎短笔与柔和点涂聚成密集闪烁色域。苔、橄榄、灰绿、冷蓝、浅金和象牙在小笔点中互混；少量红黄亮点穿插下方阴影。暗竖向体量置于明亮中央开口前，细水平竖直线条为松散环境提供简洁结构框架。光从高处背后筛入，擦亮精选边缘，并散成下方反光平面上的不规则银片。近线性细节相对清楚，周围叶丛与远形则溶为层叠纹理和雾。阴影保持有色绿褐深度，而非平黑。构图亲密隐秘，在躁动视觉闪光中稳住一个静形。节奏来自安静宽块、纤细栏线与无数承光小笔点之间的反差。
theme_en: A woman pauses at a garden balcony overlooking a luminous pond
theme_zh: 女子在花园阳台上停步，望向发光池水
name: Gaston Le Touche
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
